architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management lib (useState + context for now).

tickets.title: Create Pricing System page (src/pages/PricingSystem.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch pricing system screen to React. Include header, hero, pricing tiers, FAQ, CTA. Use Tailwind classes from design. Responsive.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements (buttons, toggles) visually match design

tickets.title: Build Services Pricing page (src/pages/ServicesPricing.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement services pricing table. Include service cards, pricing details, comparison toggle. Use Tailwind for styling.

tickets.title: Create 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement brutalist 404 page. Include error message, home link, background effect. Use CSS for animations.

tickets.title: Extract shared UI components (src/components/)
tickets.description: Create reusable components from showcase screens. Components: Button, Badge, InputSelect, Table, Toast, Loader. Use Tailwind props for variants.
acceptance_criteria: Props for all visual states (size, color, disabled, etc.)

tickets.title: Implement Toast system (src/components/Toast.jsx + context)
tickets.description: Create toast component and context provider. Support success/error/warning/info variants. Auto-dismiss after 5s. Stackable.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Create layout with navigation. Route to PricingSystem, ServicesPricing, NotFound pages. Include 404 fallback.
